# 📦 Compiled ZIP Packages (`dist/`)

> [!WARNING]
> **DO NOT EDIT FILES IN THIS DIRECTORY MANUALLY.**
> The ZIP files in this folder are automatically compiled and managed by the VoxiHost team. Any manual changes here will be lost.

## ❓ What is this directory?

This directory contains the compiled ZIP packages for all **published** articles. These ZIP files are read and rendered directly by the VoxiHost blog engine.

* Organized by locale: `en/` and `pl/`.
* Each ZIP is named after the article slug (e.g., `dist/en/secure-ssh-ubuntu-debian-package.zip`).
* Draft articles (located under `src/drafts/`) are **never** compiled into `dist/`.

## 🔄 How are ZIPs compiled?

ZIP packages are maintained exclusively by the **VoxiHost team** as part of the editorial publishing workflow. As a community contributor, you **never need to touch this directory** — just submit your Markdown files and images under `src/drafts/` and the team takes care of packaging and deployment.
